admin.label: FAQ
admin.description: Manage the questions and answers shown on the site and in the app.

permissions.manageDescription: Create and edit FAQ groups and items, publish them and delete them.
permissions.readDescription: Read the FAQ groups and answers your visibility allows.

admin.title: FAQ
admin.listDescription: Questions and answers, grouped, shown on pages and in the app.
admin.createGroupDescription: Create the group first, then add its questions.
admin.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Pages refer to the group by it.
admin.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
admin.iconHelp: An icon name such as i-lucide-info.
admin.ownerHelp: The platform, or an operation or team the group belongs to.
admin.ownerIdRequired: Enter the id of the owner.
admin.visibilityHelp: Questions can narrow this further, never widen it.

visibility.publicHelp: Everyone sees it, also without signing in. Nothing else below applies then.
visibility.inheritHelp: The question is visible to the people who can see its group. Turn this off to narrow it further.
visibility.signedIn: Signed-in people see it. Narrow it down with any of the rules below; all that are set must hold.
visibility.rolesHelp: Anyone holding at least one of these roles.
visibility.rolesPlaceholder: Type a role and press Enter
visibility.teamRoleHelp: At least this role in a team of this kind, for example a kind and its lead role.
visibility.operationHelp: Only people who take part in the operation with this id.
visibility.widens: This shows the question to more people than its group
visibility.widensHelp: An item can only narrow its group, so people the group hides it from will still not see it.

admin.itemsDescription: Drag to reorder. Only published questions show on the site.
admin.itemsEmptyDescription: Add the first question. It starts as a draft.
admin.noMatches: No FAQ groups match your search
admin.emptyDescription: Add a group, such as membership or volunteering, and fill it with questions.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to the FAQ
admin.loadFailed: The FAQ groups could not be loaded
admin.groupLoadFailed: The FAQ group could not be loaded
admin.previewDescription: What visitors see: the published questions, in the card the site uses.
admin.deleteGroupDescription: Its {count} questions are deleted with it, and pages that show it will show nothing.
admin.deleteEmptyGroupDescription: Pages that show it will show nothing.
admin.createItemDescription: It starts as a draft. Publish it when every language is filled in.
admin.itemCreated: Added the question as a draft
admin.question: Question
admin.linkToInvalid: Use a path, a web address starting with https://, or a mailto: or tel: link.
admin.deleteItemDescription: "{name}" disappears from every page that shows its group.
admin.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order
